jobDescription:
PROJECT MANAGER (IT) — join our journey!!

We are a fast-paced, dynamic, forward-thinking organization on an exciting growth journey and we are looking for a rockstar Project Manager to hit the ground running and take ownership from day one!!

You will wear many hats. You are a self-starter with a can-do attitude who thrives in ambiguity and isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves. Synergy, agility, and passion are in our DNA.

What you'll do:
- Drive things forward
- Manage stuff end to end
- Talk to stakeholders and align everyone
- Keep projects on track and on budget
- Be awesome

Who you are:
- A people person
- Organized
- Some experience managing IT projects
- Good with tools
- Fluent English

Perks: fruit, foosball, and a great culture. Apply now!!!
resume:
Tom Becker
IT Project Manager

Location: Hamburg, Germany
Languages: German (native), English (fluent, C1)

Professional Summary
IT project manager with 9 years delivering software and infrastructure projects in mid-sized enterprises, using both Scrum and traditional stage-gate approaches.

Professional Experience

IT Project Manager — Elbe Logistics AG, Hamburg (2018–present)
- Manage IT projects end to end, from initiation through delivery, typically 3-6 running in parallel.
- Own project budgets up to EUR 2M and report status to steering committees.
- Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across business, engineering, and vendors.
- Run sprint ceremonies for two Scrum teams and maintain roadmaps and risk logs.

Project Coordinator — NordSoft GmbH, Kiel (2015–2018)
- Coordinated delivery schedules, tracked dependencies, and prepared status reporting.

Certifications
- PMP (Project Management Professional)
- Professional Scrum Master I (PSM I)

Education
BSc Information Systems — University of Hamburg

Skills
Project management, stakeholder management, budget management, Scrum, risk management, Jira, MS Project
